pages.text: The Pale Saber is the standard sidearm of artillerymen, grenadiers, artillery captains, and company captains. It deals 7.0 damage at 2.5 attack speed with 962 durability.
Artillerymen and grenadiers do not carry it by default — only when cornered and forced to fight do they stow their torch or bombs and draw the Pale Saber for a last stand.
